description: Shows the replay history of one event and the fix verification verdict for the latest replay (or `replay_id`): fixed, regressed, still_failing or still_passing, compared with the attempt before it to the same URL. Includes replays made from the dashboard and by `slinghook listen`. On Pro and above it also returns both response bodies to compare.

event_id.description: Which event: its number (12 or "#12", from list_events or the dashboard), "latest", "latest <event type>" such as "latest invoice.paid", or the provider's own event id such as evt_1Qx...

replay_id.description: A specific replay attempt; default the latest

name: get_replay_result
title: Get replay result
